words.prose: {{ar:ٱنۢبَعَثَ}} ({{tr:inbaʿatha}}) is the clause's central action beat. As a perfect Form VII verb, it presents the rising as a completed fact and makes the culprit himself the one who springs forth, without an object, destination, or formal commissioning frame. The visible nasal prefix is compressed into the root onset, so the Form VII self-activation is heard as well as parsed. The wider {{ar:ب ع ث}} ({{tr:b-ʿ-th}}) field includes rousing, dispatching, and resurrection, but local grammar narrows that range to self-activated emergence from within the guilty collective. That narrowing matters: 91:11's abstract transgression becomes a body in motion, while the verb-before-subject order lets the deed arrive before {{ar:أَشْقَىٰهَا}} ({{tr:ashqāhā}}) is named. Against the prepared mobilization context at 9:46, this single perfect verb feels compact and sudden, and it launches the rapid sequence of warning speech (91:13) and collective action (91:14). The root's messenger-sending uses (2:129; 62:2) and resurrection uses (17:49; 22:7; 36:52) remain contrastive pressure, not the local sense; here the same motion-field is lowered into a destructive human rising.

words.prose: {{ar:أَشْقَىٰهَا}} ({{tr:ashqāhā}}) closes the clause by naming the delayed subject of {{ar:ٱنۢبَعَثَ}} ({{tr:inbaʿatha}}). It is not a second verb meaning to make someone wretched; local grammar makes it an elative subject, the group's most wretched one. The feminine suffix points back primarily to the prior collective in 91:11, so the word selects one extreme agent from the collective while keeping the group implicated. The repeated final suffix shape also links 91:11's transgression to this culprit, shifting from possessed excess to selected person. The {{ar:ش ق و}} ({{tr:sh-q-w}}) field makes that label more than misfortune: hardship, misery, and moral ruin converge in a maximum within the tribe, so the actor's wretchedness reads as both the ruined condition behind the act and the ruin exposed by it. That rank resonates with refusal and punishment contexts (87:11; 92:15), the fate division of the wretched (11:105-106), and prophetic non-wretchedness contrasts (19:4; 19:48). Its final position matters too; the ayah lets the rising be heard first, then lands on moral identity rather than personal biography, with a harder final texture at the point the culprit is identified. The suffix can also prepare the ear for {{ar:نَاقَةَ}} ({{tr:nāqata}}) in 91:13, but that is forward pressure only, not the primary antecedent; 91:14 then preserves the tension between one singled-out instigator and plural execution of the crime.

topics.reason: The local form is an elative/superlative adjective with a suffix, functioning as the subject of the verb and selecting one member from the group.

topics.headline: suffix ties the culprit to the prior collective

topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses the feminine suffix as resuming the prior collective from 91:11 while the elative subject remains masculine singular.

topics.headline: elative subject, not causative predicate

topics.reason: The supplied family includes a causative derivative, but local attachment and QAC evidence make {{ar:أَشْقَىٰهَا}} ({{tr:ashqāhā}}) the delayed elative subject of {{ar:ٱنۢبَعَثَ}} ({{tr:inbaʿatha}}).

topics.headline: final position makes moral identity land
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the action before the actor and then receives the culprit's moral rank as the clause's landing.
topics.reason: The verb precedes the subject, and the ayah ends on the elative subject, making the final word both grammatical resolution and moral closure.

topics.reason: The primary antecedent is the prior collective in 91:11, but the later feminine referent {{ar:نَاقَةَ}} ({{tr:nāqata}}) in 91:13 can create controlled forward pressure without replacing the local antecedent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱنۢبَعَثَ supplies an intransitive onset of motion, while أَشْقَىٰهَا selects a superlative extreme belonging to the collective.
baseline_models.mechanism: The subject is first a ranked quality within a group and then becomes its moving edge: the collective's wretched extreme converts from latent status into self-propelled action.

activation_trace.role: Setting out and pressing onward gives the event a self-propelled kinetic onset.
Wretchedness opposed to happiness supplies the qualitative extreme carried by the moving subject.

changed_reading.before: When its most wretched one rose.
changed_reading.after: When the collective's wretched extreme turned from a rank within it into its advancing edge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reflexive motion of ٱنۢبَعَثَ is read against the focus inventory's waking-from-stillness image, and أَشْقَىٰهَا against strenuous hardship.
baseline_models.mechanism: The event is activation rather than mere standing: something dormant or restrained is stirred, and what is stirred is the member or capacity most formed by difficulty and struggle.

activation_trace.role: Rousing a still or restrained thing supplies the transition from latency to agitation.
Hardship, fatigue, and strenuous handling make the activated extreme hardship-formed rather than merely morally labeled.

changed_reading.before: A bad individual simply stood up.
changed_reading.after: A dormant, hardship-formed capacity was roused into consequential motion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱنۢبَعَثَ can retain an echo of being directed toward a task, while the dominant ش ق و mapping carries prevailing in a contest of hardship.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus alone permits a social-role possibility: the extreme actor is not just impulsive but resembles a contestant who has prevailed in harsh struggle and now goes out as a task-directed agent.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and direction toward a task keep a mission-shaped reading available beneath the intransitive form.
Prevailing in a hardship contest recasts the superlative as a perverse champion or selected extreme.

changed_reading.before: An isolated villain acted on private impulse.
changed_reading.after: A hardship-contest extreme set out as though directed toward a role or task.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reveal-cover alternation, followed by images of splitting and hidden insertion, turns the focus activation into a pressure event: the collective's most hardship-laden material breaks cover and becomes visible motion.

activation_trace.role: Rousing from stillness supplies the latent-to-active transition at the center of the mechanism.
Strenuous hardship identifies what has accumulated beneath the surface and is released.
Disclosure and appearance make emergence readable as becoming exposed.
A covering laid over something supplies the prior state of occlusion.
Wide splitting and bursting give the transition a pressure-break geometry.
Secret insertion or burial supplies the hidden location from which the activated extreme surfaces.

structural_cues: جَلَّىٰهَا and يَغْشَىٰهَا establish exposure versus covering before the focus.
فُجُورَهَا and دَسَّىٰهَا place rupture and concealment around the moral sequence, while focus إِذ marks the release event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, disclosure, burial, rupture, and rousing; I supply the causal arrow that accumulated hidden pressure produces the emergence. A live alternative is that these remain parallel contrasts without a pressure sequence.

changed_reading.after: The collective's most hardship-laden capacity surfaced from concealment as a pressure release.

context_deltas.mechanism: Collective denial, the focus dispatch echo, and the immediately following messenger form two opposed missions. The singular extreme can therefore be read as the group's embodied counter-message, socially representative even if no explicit commissioning is stated.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch toward a task makes the focus actor available as a mission-bearing agent.
Prevailing in harsh contention supplies the social profile of a champion selected by escalation.
Attributing a person or claim to falsehood supplies the collective stance that the singular actor comes to embody.
Overt utterance makes the messenger's mission explicit and sharpens its contrast with the focus actor's enacted message.
Sending and setting forth mirrors the focus dispatch branch and produces rival mobilizations.

structural_cues: 91:11 predicates denial of Thamud, 91:12 selects one superlative member, and 91:14 returns to plural verbs, embedding the singular action in a collective arc.
The mobilized extreme in 91:12 is immediately followed by the named messenger in 91:13, creating a two-agent contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored dispatch roots, collective denial, and a singular-plural sequence; I infer that the extreme functions as a counter-envoy for the group. The live alternative is a lone initiator whose act the group only ratifies afterward.

changed_reading.before: The worst individual independently rushed out.
changed_reading.after: The group's extreme became its counter-envoy, answering a spoken warning with an enacted rival message.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protection, limit-crossing, the named camel, and an allotted watering share turn the focus motion into an assault on a bounded common. The extreme actor is the point where collective excess becomes interference with protected access and flow.

activation_trace.role: Pressing onward supplies the directed intervention that crosses into the protected arrangement.
Wretchedness marks the actor as the collective's destructive extreme within this allocation conflict.
Warding harm through protection supplies the idea of a boundary meant to preserve what is vulnerable.
Crossing a limit in disobedience identifies the collective force that the extreme actor converts into action.
The concrete she-camel gives the protected arrangement a living material bearer.
An allotted share of watering and its channel turn the warning into a rule of distribution and access.

structural_cues: The focus stands directly between Thamud's limit-crossing in 91:11 and the camel-plus-watering warning in 91:13.
The possessive suffix in أَشْقَىٰهَا keeps the boundary-breaker inside the collective whose resource conduct is at issue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, exceeded limits, a camel, and a watering allotment; I infer that the mobilized actor targets a regulated common. A live alternative is that the offense targets the camel only as a sign, with water allocation secondary.

changed_reading.before: The most wicked member rose for an unspecified evil act.
changed_reading.after: The collective's extreme rose to convert its excess into a breach of protected, allotted access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gives mobility to one body, then the narrative names a camel and removes the animal's locomotion. The actor's rising is thus not generic readiness but the kinetic precondition for transferring stillness and disablement onto another body.

activation_trace.role: Rousing a kneeling or restrained creature gives the focus motion a specifically animal and bodily edge.
The she-camel's concrete body supplies the counterpart onto which arrested motion will be imposed.
Cutting an animal's legs realizes the deliberate destruction of stance and locomotion.
Damage to the back and movement broadens the result from injury to systematic immobilization.

structural_cues: ٱنۢبَعَثَ in 91:12 precedes نَاقَةَ in 91:13 and عَقَرُوهَا in 91:14, yielding motion, named animal, then destroyed motion.
The singular focus actor resolves into plural perpetrators in 91:14, allowing individual initiation and collective execution to coexist.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rousing, the camel body, and severed locomotion; I supply the directional reversal that one body's mobilization enables another body's immobilization. The alternative is a simpler action-result sequence without transferred-motion symbolism.

changed_reading.before: He sprang up in order to act.
changed_reading.after: His acquired mobility became the means by which the protected animal was deprived of mobility.

context_deltas.mechanism: A proportioned whole emits its superlative outlier; after that outlier acts, uprooting and the return of the same equalizing root erase the differential. The focus becomes an extreme point suspended between formation and re-leveling.

activation_trace.role: Wretchedness, intensified by the superlative form, supplies the extreme point within the collective.
Outward pressing turns the extreme from a position in the field into a protruding event.
Equality and adjustment frame the prior whole from which the superlative member emerges.
Complete uprooting removes both the activated protrusion and the collective structure sustaining it.
The returning equalization image supplies the endpoint that abolishes the differential.

structural_cues: The repeated سَوَّىٰهَا at 91:7 and 91:14 encloses the emergence of أَشْقَىٰهَا.
The superlative morphology of أَشْقَىٰ marks an internal maximum rather than merely naming an unrelated outsider.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated equalizing root, a superlative member, outward motion, and uprooting; I infer a geometry of field, protrusion, and re-leveling. The alternative is that the two uses of س و ي carry separate senses with no enclosing design.

changed_reading.before: A morally worst person emerged from the group.
changed_reading.after: An extreme deviation projected from a proportioned whole and precipitated the re-leveling of the entire field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tail, anticipated harm, and final consequence extend the focus beyond a punctual outburst. The rising initiates an event that acquires a trailing collective sequel and terminates in an aftermath no higher agent fears.

activation_trace.role: Setting out supplies the first forward step in the consequential chain.
The tail or terminal part of a thing gives the wrongdoing an attached sequel rather than an isolated instant.
Fear as expectation of coming harm makes futurity explicit even under negation.
The last part and consequence name the terminal horizon toward which the focus action travels.
A remainder or trace preserves the idea that the act leaves something following behind it.

structural_cues: The repeated فَ sequence in 91:13-14 accelerates speech, denial, hamstringing, and destruction after the focus onset.
91:15 closes on عُقْبَاهَا, making aftermath the final lens on the event begun at إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies setting out, semantic tail, expectation, remainder, and consequence; I infer that the focus is the launch point of one continuous causal trajectory. A live alternative treats ذنب only as guilt and عقب only as punishment, without the spatial tail image.

changed_reading.before: The rising was a momentary personal outburst.
changed_reading.after: The rising launched an act with a tail: collective follow-through, destruction, and an enduring aftermath.

context_deltas.mechanism: The soul sequence permits an intrapsychic analogue: a self receives moral material, can hide it, and then its most self-destructive capacity becomes an acting subject. The historical collective and an interior economy remain co-present rather than being collapsed.

activation_trace.role: Waking a dormant thing lets an inner disposition cross into agency.
Wretchedness supplies the destructive pole personified as the self's extreme.
What lies within the self as reason or inward alarm supplies an interior arena of response.
Strength and disposition of the self allow one latent capacity to become dominant.
Swallowing and fully taking in something gives inspiration an embodied inward-incorporation image.
Hidden insertion or burial supplies the mechanism by which a destructive capacity remains latent before rising.

structural_cues: The feminine suffix chain from نَفْسٍ through فُجُورَهَا, تَقْوَاهَا, زَكَّاهَا, and دَسَّاهَا establishes an interior field before Thamud is named.
أَشْقَىٰهَا retains the same possessive shape, allowing an analogy between a collective's member and a self's activated capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the soul, inward faculties, incorporation, concealment, and the repeated feminine suffix; I extend that interior pattern analogically into the focus. The immediate contextual possessor is Thamud, so the live alternative is exclusively social-historical reference.

changed_reading.before: A historical group's worst member began acting.
changed_reading.after: Alongside the historical actor, the line models the instant a self or collective lets its most self-destructive capacity take agency.

It remains anchored in the focus branch and in surrounding rise, spread, and smooth-ground images; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial analogy, not as a replacement lexical gloss.

Dispatch toward a task turns selection into deployment.

changed_reading.after: Competitive escalation produced a perverse champion, and the collective deployed its winner.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus motion branch includes rousing a kneeling or restrained creature, allowing the rising human extreme to mirror the animal whose motion will be destroyed.

activation_trace.role: Refractoriness in animal or character imports a balking, ungoverned temperament from a distant opening branch.
Rousing a kneeling or restrained creature makes the actor's release bodily and animal-like.
Taming, training, and management position the camel as the governed counterpart to the refractory actor.

changed_reading.before: An evil human rose and attacked a camel.
changed_reading.after: A refractory human double was released from restraint and asserted its freedom by destroying the governed animal's freedom of movement.

strongest_changes: The apparently lone outburst became a collective counter-mission: the superlative member embodies group denial opposite the explicitly sent messenger.
Motion became reversible and transferable: the actor is roused so that the camel can be immobilized.
Wretchedness became a latent pressure and an extreme point within a formed collective, surfacing from concealment before the whole field is re-leveled.
The unspecified act acquired a concrete governance target in the protected camel and its allotted watering share, then grew a causal tail into collective aftermath.
summary.what_was_special: The split ش ق و mapping kept wretchedness, strenuous hardship, contest, and mountain-flank images simultaneously live. Their interaction with the dispatch mirror ب ع ث/ر س ل, repeated س و ي, animal locomotion, and the water-share branch produced personal, social, psychic, kinetic, distributive, and topographic readings without forcing one to cancel the others.
remaining_uncertainties: The dispatch reading of form VII may preserve only an echo of direction, not an external sender.
The inner-self model is analogical because Thamud intervenes before أَشْقَىٰهَا and is the nearer collective possessor.
The mountain, contest, and refractory-animal models are branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The watering share may be the act's practical target, or only one concrete expression of rejecting the protected sign.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The wretched one as roused instrument of collective overflow.** Lexical evidence: ب ع ث B001 "rousing a still thing into motion"; ش ق و B002 "hardship and strenuous suffering"; ط غ ي B001/B002 overstepping/overflow in 91:11. Structural cue: `إذ` links the collective denial to the moment the most wretched is roused. Assigned role: انبعث is the activation event; أشقىها is the person in whom collective طغوى becomes motion. Abductive move: I infer that the group condition selects or energizes the individual agent; the packet supplies collective denial followed by singular rousing. Reading change: the ayah is not an isolated villain portrait but a mechanism of social transgression becoming embodied action.

2. **Dispatch without rightful sending.** Lexical evidence: ب عث B002 "dispatching and directing"; ر س ل B001/B002 sending/messenger in 91:13; ء ل ه B002 divine formula/name. Structural cue: a roused individual appears immediately before the messenger of Allah speaks. Assigned role: بعث creates a dark counter-sending, contrasted with the رسل mission. Abductive move: I infer two missions in collision: one unauthorized by collective rebellion, one authorized by Allah; the packet supplies the juxtaposition of انبعث and رسول الله. Reading change: the ayah reads as anti-messengerhood: a social impulse dispatches its agent against the divinely sent word.

3. **Hardship contest and mountain flank.** Lexical evidence: ش ق و B003 "prevailing in a hardship contest"; ش ق و B004 "long rising mountain flank"; ط غ ي B005 high outcrop in 91:11; ع ق ب B012 steep pass in 91:15. Structural cue: the root after طغوى and before عقر/عقبها is one with both suffering and climbable terrain. Assigned role: أشقىها may be the one most sunk in hardship or the one who "wins" the contest of ruin. Abductive move: I infer that moral extremity is pictured as a contest/climb where the worst reaches the decisive position; the packet supplies contest and terrain branches. Reading change: "most wretched" becomes dynamic: the one who presses farthest along the hard slope of transgression.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The next two ayat made `انبعث` a counter-mission. Before reading 91:13, the roused wretched one could be only an impulsive criminal; after `رسول الله`, he becomes a socially dispatched anti-messenger whose movement collides with the authorized sending. The terrain branches in ط غ ي, ش ق و, and ع ق ب also made his wretchedness feel like movement along a hard slope toward consequence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A human rising that inverts the camel image.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ب ع ث/B001` is rousing a kneeling or restrained camel into motion; 91:13 introduces the she-camel and 91:14 cuts her down through `ع ق ر/B002`. **Structural cue and role:** the human subject rises first and then disables the animal that the root-image ordinarily rouses, making his motion a reversal of animation into immobilization. **Abductive move:** the camel branch and later animal are supplied; treating their sequence as deliberate inversion is inferred. **Reading change:** `انبعث` becomes a grotesquely misdirected activation, not neutral standing up.

2. **A counter-mission.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ب ع ث/B002` is dispatching a person, messenger, camel, or force toward a task; 91:13 `ر س ل/B002` names messenger and message. **Structural cue and role:** the self-launched `أشقاها` is immediately answered by a messenger bearing a protected claim, so dispatch supplies two opposed trajectories. **Abductive move:** the two movements are explicit, while calling the first a counter-mission to the second is relational inference. **Reading change:** the ayah marks not only an individual's initiative but an anti-dispatch set against the communicated order.

3. **Latent corruption becoming kinetic.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ب ع ث/B004` is setting out and pressing onward in good or evil; 91:10 `د س و/B003` is inward spoilage and 91:14 supplies the completed act. **Structural cue and role:** concealed self, collective denial, individual setting-out, warning, and violence form successive stages; `انبعث` is the conversion point from disposition to motion. **Abductive move:** the stages are supplied; the causal direction from inner spoilage to mobilized harm is inferred. **Reading change:** this brief ayah becomes the hinge at which a latent moral state acquires a body and trajectory.

4. **A perverse winner whose rise is temporary.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ش ق و/B003` is prevailing in a hardship contest and `ش ق و/B004` is a long rising mountain flank; 91:11 `ط غ ي/B005` supplies a high outcrop and 91:14 `س و ي/B001` equalizes. **Structural cue and role:** the superlative `أشقاها` rises from the group, occupies the action, and is followed by leveling, so competitive and topographic prominence converge in a short-lived role. **Abductive move:** the contest and terrain images are dormant and their convergence is exploratory; sequence supplies the rise and leveling but not a literal mountain. **Reading change:** "most wretched" can denote the one who wins a destructive competition and mistakes prominence for durable elevation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 91:13 made `ب ع ث/B001` unexpectedly self-reversing: the human rises just before the she-camel appears, then 91:14 shows him participate in making her fall. The same later ayah levels the temporary elevation activated by `ش ق و/B004`, correcting prominence into a prelude to erasure.

findings.text: En kötü kişinin harekete geçmesi, topluluğun sınır aşan eğiliminin tek bir bedende yön ve hız kazanarak şiddete dönüşmesidir.
Normalde çökmüş bir deveyi ayağa kaldırmayı çağrıştıran hareket, burada bir insanın kalkıp hemen ardından deveyi yere düşürmesiyle tersine çevrilir.
Bu çıkış, hemen ardından gelen Allah'ın elçisinin haklı gönderilişine karşı yönelmiş yetkisiz bir karşı görev gibi işler.
En kötü kişi, zorluk yarışında öne çıkan ve yükselen bir dağ yamacına tırmanan kişi gibi, yıkıcı bir yarışın geçici galibi olarak görülebilir.
